videos.title: All The Guides - Mystical Agriculture in ATM 10
The Complete Guide to Mystical Agriculture!

order: Mine the ore first, with any pickaxe. Guide: 'To start with mystical agriculture, you need this inferium ore that you can just break with a stone [pickaxe]... as soon as you have broken it, you get this Inferium essence.' -> mysticalagriculture:inferium_ore / mysticalagriculture:deepslate_inferium_ore -> mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence. The jar agrees: inferium_essence_smelted.json smelts tag forge:ores/inferium.

Prosperity is the second ore and it is what makes seeds possible at all. Guide: 'You need prosperity shards to make the seeds look good later.' mysticalagriculture:prosperity_ore -> mysticalagriculture:prosperity_shard -> mysticalagriculture:prosperity_seed_base.
First craft is a seed, not a machine: guide combines the seed base 'with 8 inferium essence to create a few inferium seeds' -> mysticalagriculture:inferium_seeds. Farming essence beats mining it.

The first BUILD is the infusion altar. Guide: 'the first thing you probably want to do is to build this altar for the infusion, because here you will create all your seeds.' mysticalagriculture:infusion_altar surrounded by 8x mysticalagriculture:infusion_pedestal.

mysticalagriculture:infusion_crystal is the tool that drives the whole tier ladder. Guide: 'The key ... is an infusion crystal, with which you can simply combine four essences of a level with an essence of the next higher level.'

Tier ladder, confirmed against the jar recipes (each step is 4 of the lower essence + an infusion crystal in a plus shape): mysticalagriculture:inferium_essence -> mysticalagriculture:prudentium_essence -> mysticalagriculture:tertium_essence -> mysticalagriculture:imperium_essence -> mysticalagriculture:supremium_essence.

Once supremium exists, replace the consumable crystal: mysticalagriculture:master_infusion_crystal (prosperity shards + supremium essence + mysticalagriculture:supremium_gemstone). Guide: 'Later in the game you can use the Supremium Essence to create a master infusion crystal that can often be used unlimitedly.'

Endgame is a second altar, not a sixth essence tier: mysticalagriculture:awakening_altar with 4x mysticalagriculture:awakening_pedestal AND 4x mysticalagriculture:essence_vessel around it. Guide: 'You will need 4 essence containers placed around the altar, as well as 4 pedestals of the awakening. Keep in mind that to make them you need something with soulstone.' Output is mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_essence, then mysticalagriculture:awakened_supremium_ingot and the awakened gear.

Mob drops come last and need their own tool: mysticalagriculture:soulium_dagger (hostile and passive variants in the recipe set) to harvest mob essences, then mysticalagriculture:soul_extractor / mysticalagriculture:soul_jar.
gates: Hard gate on every seed: the infusion altar plus its 8 pedestals. Nothing in the mod is craftable in a 3x3 beyond the essence ladder itself.

Tier gate on every crop: a crop's seed recipe consumes the essence of that crop's own tier, so tier-4/5 resources (mysticalagriculture:netherite_seeds, mysticalagriculture:draconium_seeds) are unreachable until imperium/supremium exist. The jar encodes this as crop_component 'essence' rather than a literal item, so a recipe scan alone will not show which tier a seed needs.
mysticalagriculture:awakening_altar gates all awakened supremium gear.
mysticalagriculture:soulium_dagger gates every mob essence (mysticalagriculture:skeleton_essence, mysticalagriculture:creeper_essence, etc.).

Armor tiers gate their own upgrades. Guide: 'if you want to have the health boost of level 4, you either need armor of level 4 or 5, because only then you can put it on' - mysticalagriculture:supremium_chestplate etc. accept higher-tier augments than mysticalagriculture:inferium_chestplate.
mysticalagriculture:soulstone is the build material for the awakening altar (jar: awakening_altar.json = soulstone + gold + orange wool).
mechanics: Essence is a currency, not a crop: every resource in the pack becomes a seed, and the seed yields that resource's essence, which is crafted back into the resource. 667 item ids in the jar are almost entirely <resource>_seeds / <resource>_essence pairs.
The 4:1 infusion step is deliberately lossy in reverse - each *_uncraft recipe gives 4 of the tier below, so tiers are a real sink.

mysticalagriculture:seed_reprocessor returns some seed cost, and tiered mysticalagriculture:inferium_farmland .. mysticalagriculture:supremium_farmland plus mysticalagriculture:inferium_growth_accelerator .. mysticalagriculture:supremium_growth_accelerator are the speed levers.

Watering cans (mysticalagriculture:watering_can up to mysticalagriculture:supremium_watering_can) are the cheap early speed-up; guide spends real time on farm layout, so throughput matters more than variety.
traps: Do not keep mining essence ore. Guide: 'Of course you don't want to do this forever, but it is extremely useful in the early game.' Mining inferium is a bootstrap only.

Do not treat the guides' 'Insanium' tier as part of this mod. There is NO insanium id anywhere in MysticalAgriculture-1.20.1-7.0.24.jar - it is Mystical Agradditions, which is not installed. Both guides conflate the two: one opens with 'everything you need to know about Mystical Agriculture and its complementary mod, Mystical Agradditions' and then teaches them as one ladder. A quest ladder that ends at insanium would be uncompletable.

Enchanting/repairing tier gear is described as not worth the effort ('you don't have to make them unbreakable, don't repair, absolutely nothing') - the gear is replaced by the next tier rather than maintained.
human_notes.pack_status: NOT INSTALLED in the reference pack. Analysed against MysticalAgriculture-1.20.1-7.0.24.jar fetched to scratch from Modrinth. Its addon Mystical Agradditions (the Insanium tier) is also absent - see traps.
